# Edge AI Deployment Research Summary

## 1. Key Technical Claims by Article

### `article1_edge_ai.html` - "The Rise of Edge AI Hardware"
- **Memory capacity is the primary constraint**: Edge platforms with 128GB unified memory can fit 30B+ parameter models locally, avoiding distributed inference latency overhead
- **Hardware performance**: AMD Ryzen AI Max+ with 128GB unified memory achieves ~45 tokens/sec on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B with iGPU
- **MoE advantage**: Mixture-of-Expert architectures are particularly attractive for edge—full model fits in memory but only ~3B parameters activate per token
- **Latency threshold**: Time-to-first-token (TTFT) under 500ms feels "instant" to users; with prefix caching, long-context tasks can hit sub-200ms TTFT
- **Claim**: "Always-on" AI agent paradigm is now viable on consumer hardware
